title: Fundamental-group exact sequence for a punctured local spectrum and its strict henselization
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: A cover trivialized over the strictly henselian punctured spectrum must extend over the original local spectrum. The proof analyzes the double and triple strict-henselian fibre products to extend the descent isomorphism and its cocycle across the missing closed points, then applies effective affine descent.
